Equity, futures, gold and forex market research

Explore equities, futures, gold, forex and digital assets with VIS Markets. When comparing price histories, check trading hours, quote units, equity price adjustments and futures rolls.

VIS Markets

Service areas

01

Equity prices and adjustments

Splits and dividends affect historical comparisons. When studying a stock, record whether the series uses raw or adjusted closes and which corporate actions the adjustment covers.

02

Futures contracts and rolls

The same underlying can have multiple delivery months. Check the contract code and expiry. For a continuous series, also check when the data rolls and how prices are joined.

03

Gold and forex quotes

For XAUUSD or a currency pair, align timestamps and time zones. Identify whether a series records bids, asks or midpoints before estimating spread costs.
